# Equipment lending reference consumer

Hand-authored fictional upgrade input. This is neither generated live evidence nor
a claim that an agent completed a historic bootstrap. Admission must install and
verify the pinned released Program Kit archives, restore native locks, execute the
independent HTTP/browser checks, and preserve the complete consumer inventory.

The reference's deliberately small browser and API preserve a V1 behavior contract.
The fresh candidate trial separately exercises public immutable Forms production
and rendering. New candidate obligations may require explicit upgrade remediation;
the baseline must never be relabelled as having passed those newer gates.

`Lending.FixtureHost` is a disposable acceptance host. Its test controls are available
only in the `ProgramKitAcceptanceFixture` environment; it is not a deployed service.
